content: pgserver (PyPI, 0.1.4, 2024-06-08, github.com/orm011/pgserver) ships manylinux/macOS/Windows wheels containing PostgreSQL binaries and starts a server from Python with no root and no Docker. Verified: bundles PostgreSQL 16.2, starts on a unix socket under a chosen data dir. Alternatives pytest-postgresql and testing.postgresql both require a pre-existing system PostgreSQL install.
